title: Repair published Helius smoke evidence references
objective: Replace ignored local run-manifest inputs in the DONE Helius smoke task with committed, scrubbed and reproducible upstream evidence. Add a Harness ledger gate that rejects DONE tasks whose repository-file inputs are missing, and on a clean tree also rejects inputs that are not Git-tracked.
forbidden_actions: Do not commit ignored Harness run directories, acceptance logs, credentials, raw provider payloads, credential-bearing URLs or reconstructed secret-bearing artifacts.
Do not change Helius runtime behavior, providers, chain activation, automation, persistence or production infrastructure.
Do not fabricate missing historical manifests or claim ignored local logs are public evidence.
